reasons: The gate's p-value sits exactly at the Monte Carlo resolution floor: p = 9.999e-05 = p_floor = 1/(b+1) with b = 10000, and the report itself flags at_floor = true. With 0 exceedances out of 10000 max-statistic draws the simulation cannot resolve how small p is -- it only establishes p <= 1e-4 -- so the decisive number is a censoring limit, not a measured probability.

The per-trial FAR column is censored at its own resolution floor of 0.0005: ranks 1 through 204 all carry best_far = 0.0005 exactly (204-way tie at the top), so the uncorrected/BH/Holm views cannot resolve or even order the head of the campaign. The BH(336) vs Holm(0) split is an artifact of that floor -- Holm's first threshold is 0.05/400 = 0.000125, below the 0.0005 floor, so Holm can never advance while BH's step-up accepts everything tied at 0.0005. The three views therefore disagree for a mechanical reason (floor + the documented 10-17x FAR miscalibration), not for a statistical one, and none of the three per-trial p-values is usable as evidence.

The campaign winner was never evaluated on the validation split (_validation: NOT RUN), so the reported score, sortino and margin are all in-sample; there is no out-of-sample number anywhere in the evidence that could corroborate the 0.626 best score or the 0.400 deflation margin.
auditors.confidence_note: I could not see a per-session PnL series, so I could not test whether the reported skew of 2.60 and kurtosis of 10.62 mean one or two of the 384 sessions are carrying the sortino.

The docstring is technical (focused on size-scaling tweaks to #384) and does not articulate the economic hypothesis development; the actual current hypothesis lives in the class docstring 'Follow strong-close opening-range breakouts and fade weak-close ones' and the mode-selection logic — both arms of the original question are exercised with a stated condition (close_location vs close_strength threshold), so the direction-open framing is respected. Economics look healthy: commission is 1.24% of gross, net P&L is positive, holding period is ~28 minutes, sessions with exposure is 95% of 384, and 559 fills are far from degenerate; I cannot tell whether the trade_count metric counts fills or round trips, which would slightly change the read on per-session participation but not materially.
